# Demore Technology Solutions

Demore Technology Solutions is a studio with two offers in one brand.

1. Digital systems. Custom websites and online stores. Social media auto-posting bots. Audio and video made for social. Awareness systems that point traffic at pages built to convert.

2. Insurance claim supplements. Help homeowners and contractors document missed scope and pursue a more complete carrier payout. A supplement is a documented correction, not a fight. First carrier estimates often omit code items, access and height, flashings, waste, and hidden damage. Demore Technology Solutions is not an insurer and is not a public adjuster unless licensed in that state. Payment increases are not guaranteed.

Based in Mentor, Lake County, Ohio. Serving businesses nationwide. Work is remote.

Brand lockup: neon orbital mark plus metallic DEMORE / TECHNOLOGY SOLUTIONS. Favicon is the orbital mark only.

## Growth stack
SEO means can they find you.
AEO means can a search, voice, or AI Overview lift you as the answer.
GEO means will ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, or Copilot cite you in a synthesized answer.

Rankings, AI citations, conversion lifts, and claim payment increases are not guaranteed.
